messages:
priya: Hey folks — noticed diff panel export counts don't match UI when comparing quantized 8-bit vs float32. CSV says 1200 rows, UI shows 1184. Anyone seen this?

samir: Huh, saw something similar yesterday. Might be a filter edge-case in the drilldown query. Which run id?

priya: run_id=2026-03-17-enc1

eva: @samir @priya I can repro. Steps: open Scorecards > Model compare > select two commits > click 'drilldown' > click 'Export CSV'. Attached console logs:  

samir: likely related to `payload.sample_id` dedup in backend. CI change renamed `sample_id`->`example_id` last week, maybe query used both.

priya: here's the quick query I used in console to fetch rows: 
```
GET /api/scorecards/drilldown?run=2026-03-17-enc1&pair=quant_vs_float
```
Response length: 1184

samir: if export pipeline streams raw events it might include duplicates before aggregation. I can put a small fix — dedupe by example_id and add unit test.

ci-bot: build #4452 failed on `eval-harness` tests (timeout on runner/metrics).

eva: CI failure might be blocking merge. @samir can you add the test and ping me, I'll run the failing export locally.

samir: will do. Patch will: 1) normalize IDs in SQL (`coalesce(example_id, sample_id)`), 2) add dedupe stage, 3) add regression test comparing export rows to UI rows.

priya: thanks. Also can we add a lightweight diff count sanity check in the UI (show exported_rows vs displayed_rows) so ops can detect mismatch?

eva: agree. UI change as follow-up. For now we need green CI.

samir: ETA today EOD. ping me if still failing.
